title: Everett Allen Photography
tagline: There is art in your body. Be sexy, get ugly, it's all beautiful.
contact_intro: Have a question about my work? Whether you're interested in booking a portrait session, event photography, purchasing a photo, or just want to chat about a creative project, I'd love to hear from you. Send me a message, and let's make something great together!
usage_note: Photos can be licensed for social media use or ordered as prints. Please get in touch. If you post one of my photos, please credit it as "Photo by Everett Allen Photography."
